title: Mean change from adding a coordinate
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The mean after replacing all coordinates in $J\cup\{i\}$ by $1$ equals the mean after replacing the coordinates in $J$ by $1$, plus the influence of coordinate $i$ on the resulting function.
